question: Should OpenClaw adopt this fixed-retention shared-SQLite gateway restart ledger as a canonical operator record?
rationale: Code review can validate redaction and ordering, but choosing durable restart attribution, its retention limit, and its privacy contract requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Adopt the bounded ledger
options.body: Approve the restart-only implementation after the unrelated model-selection change is removed and the storage invariants remain proven.

options.title: Keep attribution ephemeral
options.body: Decline the table and retain restart forensics in existing logs and diagnostics rather than canonical shared state.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded ledger
recommendation.body: Approve the restart-only implementation after the unrelated model-selection change is removed and the storage invariants remain proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest overlap across restart behavior and shared SQLite state design.
